verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack addresses fund segregation, custody of held/in-flight balances, yield on balances, or how platform funds are separated from Tilled's own accounts — the docs cover payments, onboarding, disputes, and dashboards but nothing on treasury/ledger custody. This is a fair question for a payments/PSP platform (finance leads care where funds sit), so the axis applies but is unaddressed.
